# Fanficly

> Fanficly is a free, ad-free app for reading fanfiction from Archive of Our Own (AO3) on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Windows. It has no Fanficly account or server, no analytics and no ads. It is an independent app, not affiliated with AO3 or the Organization for Transformative Works.

## Download

- [App Store (iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775897153): iOS 17 or later, macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- [Microsoft Store (Windows)](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PH24K7ZCZTX): Windows 10 version 2004 or later, Windows 11, on x64 and ARM64

## What it does

- Search AO3 with keywords; live tag suggestions turn fandoms, ships, characters and tropes into exact filters. Every AO3 filter is available (rating, warnings, categories, completion, crossovers, word count, language, included and excluded tags, sort). Typed words are never silently reinterpreted.
- Browse fandoms by media category, and see the fandoms, ships and characters with the most works.
- Three reading modes: continuous scroll, chapter by chapter, and page by page, with a two-page spread on wide screens. Themes, fonts, text size, spacing and margins, saved as typography profiles.
- Reading position saved to the paragraph; the library shows progress and a Finished badge.
- Read aloud with the device's own voices, entirely on-device.
- Works with Bluetooth page turners and scroll remotes (keyboard or touch mode, or volume mode with the opt-in "Volume buttons turn pages" setting) as well as hardware keyboards.
- Library with folders, stars, pins, sorting and search; download works for offline reading; import EPUB files (AO3 downloads or any e-book); export as EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF or HTML.
- Follow works and authors without an account and get notifications for new chapters and new works; turn on alerts for a saved search to hear about new fics that match it.
- Reading stats (stories finished, time and words read, streak, top fandoms, ships and authors) with a yearly wrap-up card.
- Optional AO3 sign-in for bookmarks, subscriptions, comments and kudos. The password goes only to AO3; only AO3's session cookie is kept, in the device's secure keychain.
- Widgets for the story you're reading on the iPhone and iPad home and lock screens and on Windows.
